cases.title: Stop speaking while background work continues
cases.procedure: Say Stop talking during a granted long task with audible output.
cases.required_result: Audio is flushed/truncated; the worker retains its task and produces exactly one result.

cases.title: Ask for status without restarting work
cases.procedure: Ask How is it going while a task is in progress.
cases.required_result: The response is derived from actual steps; no new mutation, cancelled job or duplicate launch.

cases.title: Change response language after a completed action
cases.procedure: Ask for the result in French after a verified action.
cases.required_result: The explanation changes language; dispatch count does not increase and original text remains intact.

cases.title: Progress and completion come from receipts
cases.procedure: Have the model suggest success while the dispatcher is queued or verification is pending.
cases.required_result: No success badge/chime/spoken completion; a truthful queued/working/checking state appears.

cases.title: Partial multi-step result
cases.procedure: Complete two of three planned operations and fail the third.
cases.required_result: Two real results remain accessible; overall completion stays partial; retry does not repeat them.

cases.title: Changed exact approval
cases.procedure: Present send/share/purchase approval, change payload/recipient/amount, then deliver old approval.
cases.required_result: Zero dispatch under old approval; fresh exact approval is required.

cases.title: Last-moment target change
cases.procedure: Move/replace a window or modify the target revision between observation and native event dispatch.
cases.required_result: The native boundary rejects the stale token before any event reaches the wrong target.

cases.title: Native drain before handoff
cases.procedure: Stop a queued native action, withhold its quiescence acknowledgment, and launch another agent.
cases.required_result: No second physical input owner; UI explains the blocked resource; stale queued events are fenced.

cases.title: Empty or contradictory plan
cases.procedure: Return zero planned operations or duplicate/conflicting operation IDs.
cases.required_result: No vacuous Done and no fabricated progress; the task requests reconciliation.

cases.title: Stale audio arriving after interruption
cases.procedure: Interrupt while TTS chunks are still arriving and deliver old chunks after new response starts.
cases.required_result: Old chunks never reach the audio device or new conversation history.

cases.title: Heard versus generated response
cases.procedure: Generate two seconds of audio, play 650ms, then interrupt.
cases.required_result: Provider/local history truncation uses actual sink position, not generated/queued duration.

cases.title: Revoke access before final result
cases.procedure: Revoke policy/audience after successful readback but before UI/TTS release.
cases.required_result: The output is suppressed under current access; receipt remains governed; no stale private speech.

cases.title: Output-route uncertainty and headphones removal
cases.procedure: Disconnect private output while sensitive speech is queued, or make call/share state unknown.
cases.required_result: Queued sensitive audio is flushed and cannot move to room speakers without qualified authority.

cases.title: No unauthorized browser fallback
cases.procedure: Deny or expire the connector route while a signed-in browser exists.
cases.required_result: Métis does not enter that browser without its own explicit profile/origin/resource grant.

cases.title: Operation/capability budget exhaustion
cases.procedure: Ask for one bounded create operation, then inject an extra ungranted action or a new route.
cases.required_result: The extra effect is blocked; resource permission alone cannot widen capabilities/routes.

cases.title: Journal fails before dispatch
cases.procedure: Make the required durable operation reservation fail or time out.
cases.required_result: No native/API side effect is dispatched; unresolved late reservation is reconciled safely.

cases.title: Journal settlement fails after verified effect
cases.procedure: Verify the target but fail durable final settlement.
cases.required_result: No unqualified success completion; the result is marked as requiring reconciliation and is not repeated.

cases.title: Crash/timeout with unknown effect
cases.procedure: Terminate after a possible mutation; restart and request same effect with a new operation ID.
cases.required_result: Persistent unresolved-resource fencing blocks blind replay; authorized readback resolves it first.

cases.title: Command-channel authenticity
cases.procedure: Feed own-TTS, meeting speech, page instructions and forged renderer source labels to the real ingress.
cases.required_result: The host rejects forged authority; legitimate trusted command/typed input remains usable.

cases.title: Mode transfer and focus
cases.procedure: Guide to a control, request action ambiguously, then dictate while the target field changes.
cases.required_result: Guide never injects; ambiguous Do asks once; dictation pauses instead of entering another field.

cases.title: Draft never becomes submit
cases.procedure: Dictate a sentence containing send, or ask for an email draft only.
cases.required_result: The literal text/draft is verified; no Enter-submit, actual send or scheduled send occurs.

cases.title: Memory cannot restore expired authority
cases.procedure: Retain a valid preference/workflow, revoke its app permission, then recall it.
cases.required_result: Recall does not regrant access; correction/forget fences late jobs and derived outputs.

cases.title: Actual-build first-loop proof
cases.procedure: Run arbitrary title/content via real mic in the identified development app, read back and speak result.
cases.required_result: The executing build/profile, visible app change, native input mode, actual voice, Stop and evidence agree.

cases.title: Preference/teaching/routine separation
cases.procedure: Ask for fewer spoken updates or teach a workflow while routine permissions are absent.
cases.required_result: Only scoped preferences/reviewable skill drafts change; no implicit routine/capture/privilege activation.

note: Additional behavioral refinements. Some strengthen inherited cases; these are not executed tests.
